_provenance.upstream_operation: KDA HKDF SP 800-56Cr2 (hybrid shared secret Z || T, fixedInfo uPartyInfo||vPartyInfo||l, concatenation encoding)
_provenance.local_operation: C_CreateObject(CKK_GENERIC_SECRET, CKA_DERIVE, CKA_VALUE = Z || T) then C_DeriveKey(CKM_HKDF_DERIVE, CK_HKDF_PARAMS{bExtract, bExpand, prfHashMechanism = the hmacAlg digest, CKF_HKDF_SALT_DATA = salt, pInfo = uPartyId || uEphemeralData || vPartyId || vEphemeralData || L (32-bit big-endian, bits)}) into a generic secret of L/8 bytes; its CKA_VALUE compared to dkm (AFT: must equal; VAL testPassed=false: must differ)
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. Single-expansion groups: AFT per (hmacAlg, saltMethod) the case with the shortest Z || T (hybrid shared secret), ties by lowest tcId — every HMAC hash of the sample (all ten have a PKCS#11 prfHashMechanism), default and random salt; VAL per hmacAlg the testPassed=false case with the shortest Z || T. Multi-expansion groups, by the same rule: AFT per (hmacAlg, saltMethod) the shortest Z || T, VAL per hmacAlg the testPassed=false case with the shortest Z || T; every expansion of a chosen case is run. The other multi-expansion cases are listed in notExecuted as metadata only.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, testPassed (VAL), kdfParameter (salt, z, t, l, hmacAlg, pattern/encoding), fixedInfoPartyU/V, dkm (deferred dropped)
_provenance.construction_note: The local fixedInfo construction (partyId || ephemeralData for U then V, then L as a 32-bit big-endian bit count) and IKM = Z || T were checked against all 1000 single-expansion upstream cases with an independent HKDF (Python hashlib/hmac) before the subset was cut: 1000/1000 dispositions reproduced.
